idea.title: The wrong-number Thanksgiving
idea.summary: A grandmother's mistyped Thanksgiving invite reaches a teenage stranger in 2016, he asks if he can still come, and they keep sharing the holiday.
hookOptions: A grandma texted the wrong number. A stranger came.
Wrong number. Best dinner invite ever.
She invited a stranger to Thanksgiving by accident
A teen got a Thanksgiving invite from a stranger
sources: Wikipedia/news coverage: In 2016 Wanda Dench of Arizona sent a Thanksgiving invitation text meant for her grandson to a wrong number; it reached Jamal Hinton, then 17.
Hinton asked if he could still come and she said yes; their photo spread online, and they have shared Thanksgiving together in the years since.

scenes.say: A grandma texted the wrong number, and a stranger came to Thanksgiving.
Wanda Dench, 2016. She texted her grandson a Thanksgiving invite. Wrong number.
It reached Jamal Hinton, 17, a total stranger she had never met.
He texted back, asking if he could still come. She said of course.
Their photo went online, and they've shared Thanksgiving most years since.

scenes.sub: Every friend was a stranger once
scenes.say: Every friend you have was a stranger once.

post.caption:
A grandma mistyped a number in 2016. The stranger who got it asked if he could still come, and they've kept sharing Thanksgiving since. Would you have said yes?
